recipe.title: Vanilla Berry Protein Waffle Bowl
recipe.summary: Creamy vanilla protein yogurt topped with fresh strawberries and served with four warm waffle half-circles for dipping.
recipe.story: This is the kind of breakfast that feels fun without requiring any real cooking. The protein powder turns the yogurt into a thicker vanilla dip, and cutting two round waffles in half keeps the serving easy to dip.
ingredients: 1 cup Oikos Triple Zero Vanilla Greek Yogurt
1/2 scoop Clean Simple Eats Simply Vanilla Protein Powder
instructions: Toast the waffles according to package directions.
Stir the protein powder into the Greek yogurt until smooth and creamy.
Top the yogurt with the sliced strawberries.
Cut each round waffle in half to make four half-circle waffle pieces.
Serve the warm waffle halves alongside the yogurt bowl for dipping.
tips: Cut each waffle once through the center so all four pieces keep a rounded outer edge.
Do not cut the waffles into sticks.
Nutrition is approximate and may vary by yogurt and protein powder formulation.
